description.value: Doppio Zero is an Italian sit-down restaurant in Coquitlam specializing in Vera Pizza Napoletana alongside house-made pastas, antipasti, and an Italian-focused wine list. The kitchen takes its craft seriously — the award-winning Boschetti pizza features truffle cream, speck DOP, and shaved parmesan — making it a memorable stop for cyclists looking for a proper meal rather than a quick bite. Reservations are recommended as the restaurant may close early on slow nights.

address.value: 103-1655 Como Lake Avenue, Coquitlam, BC V3J 3P7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active (2026 copyright), confirming the business is open; phone number matches OSM exactly, but the website contact page reveals a unit number (103) not present in OSM. The menu pages confirm vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options explicitly; the 'Order Online' link in navigation confirms takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address lacks unit number: website contact page lists '103-1655 Como Lake Avenue' while OSM has only '1655 Como Lake Avenue'. The website address with unit 103 and postal code V3J 3P7 is likely more accurate and has been used as the canonical address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible sit-down restaurant with a confirmed web presence and clear business address. Useful to touring cyclists seeking a full meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks numerous items as vegetarian (V) across all courses; 'Beyond – Vegan' pizza available; gluten-free pasta offered as a substitute on pasta dishes

wow_evidence: award-winning Boschetti pizza features truffle cream, speck DOP, and shaved parmesan
